release_notes: The PWA landing constructor becomes a funnel builder: the in-browser visit is an ordered list of screens — your own screens (lobby / slot / wheel / custom HTML, up to five), the install-instructions screen at any position (Safari steps on iOS, Chrome-menu steps elsewhere) and the push card in the browser flow. The first enabled step replaces the store as the first thing a cold visitor sees, and every screen activation is beaconed into the tracker: entry/last screen on the click row, a capped per-screen view log, a screen-views metric across the dashboard, campaign lists, reports and the Landings/Offers tables, entry/last screen Group-By dimensions and filters, plus a per-landing funnel card showing views, entries, exits and screen-to-screen transitions. Each screen step runs its own tracking script when the screen is actually shown. The constructor is funnel-first now: a dedicated Screens step owns the builder and the live preview opens on the first enabled step, while the Store and Reviews wizard steps — and every listing-only section — exist only while the store is in the funnel. Postbacks convert non-base-currency payouts into the account currency before recording (PR #9), with fx_orig_* audit macros for receivers that need the raw network values.
